title: Booking held
description: A place or a time range is held for a customer and the Tenant may now charge through Billing and then confirm. The event carries the booking's complete current state. `bookingVersion` is monotonic per booking, so a receiver that keeps the booking's state drops a delivery whose version is not newer than the one it holds. The event's `aggregate` is `booking/<bookingId>`. This schema describes the `data` member; the envelope is described in ../../messaging/README.md.

bookingVersion.description: Monotonic per booking; a receiver drops a delivery whose version is not newer than the one it holds.

status.description: The booking is held, not yet confirmed.

customerRef.description: The Tenant's opaque reference for its customer. Booking stores no personal data.

source.description: Who asked for the hold: the Tenant System, the public gate, or the waitlist worker.

qty.description: Number of places held; 1 for an interval booking.

sessionId.description: The capacity session, for a CAPACITY offering.

poolCode.description: The session pool the places came from, for a CAPACITY offering.

startsAt.description: The claimed start instant in UTC, for an INTERVAL offering.

endsAt.description: The claimed end instant in UTC, for an INTERVAL offering.

resources.description: Every resource the booking claimed, with the requirement it satisfies. Empty for a capacity booking.

seriesId.description: The series this occurrence belongs to, when the hold came from a series.

holdExpiresAt.description: When the hold lapses unless confirmed or extended.

occurredAt.description: When the hold was created, in UTC.
